name: Oma
source:
When he wakes, the Demon Lord he is supposed to defeat is already moments from demise. On the outside, he is a hero of a fantasy world, but he is just an average guy of the modern world.

He has no memories of his adventures nor heroic powers. Yet, he is celebrated as the hero who saved the realm.
